posts.title: Boundary Hedges
posts.description: POSTED AT THE MANOR GATE The following notice is issued for immediate compliance. Parishioners are reminded that boundary hedges are not to be altered, extended or otherwise appropriated without proper agreement. posts.title: Strongman Contest
posts.description: POSTED AT THE MANOR GATE Be it known throughout the village... The winner of this year's Strongman Contest shall receive one silver penny and the honour of lifting whatever Brother Geoffrey has most recently become stuck beneath. The current favourite is the midden heap. Thomas Clodwell Reeve of Middle Woe

posts.title: Transport Strike
posts.description: POSTED AT THE MANOR GATE By authority of the Manor... Cart horses have withdrawn their service. Journey times are expected to double. Oxen are considering a sympathy strike. The goose has already crossed the picket line but nobody is sure whose side it is on. Thomas Clodwell, Reeve of Middle Woe
